    {id:"encounters",icon:"🩺",labelEn:"Today's Encounters",labelAr:"زيارات اليوم",color:"#ea580c",fetch:()=>new Promise(r=>{frappe.call({method:"frappe.client.get_count",args:{doctype:"Patient Encounter",filters:{encounter_date:frappe.datetime.get_today()}},async:true,callback:d=>r(d?.message||0),error:()=>r(0)});})},
    {id:"lab-tests",icon:"🔬",labelEn:"Pending Lab Tests",labelAr:"فحوصات معلقة",color:"#dc2626",fetch:()=>new Promise(r=>{frappe.call({method:"frappe.client.get_count",args:{doctype:"Lab Test",filters:{docstatus:0}},async:true,callback:d=>r(d?.message||0),error:()=>r(0)});})}
  ];

  const quickActionButtons=[

    {doctype:"Patient Encounter",icon:"🩺",labelEn:"Encounter",labelAr:"زيارة مريض",color:"#2563eb"},

    {doctype:"Lab Test",icon:"🔬",labelEn:"Lab Test",labelAr:"فحص مخبري",color:"#ea580c"}

  const footerInfo={phone:"0115110455",email:"sales@mubtkir.com",website:"www.mubtkir.com",labels:{phoneEn:"Phone",phoneAr:"الهاتف الموحد",emailEn:"Email",emailAr:"البريد الإلكتروني",websiteEn:"Website",websiteAr:"الموقع"}};

  const sections=[["Reports & Masters",[
    ["Masters","🏥",["Patient","Healthcare Practitioner","Practitioner Schedule","Medical Department","Patient Care Type"]],
    ["Consultation","🩺",["Patient Appointment","Vital Signs","Patient Encounter","Clinical Procedure","Fee Validity"]],

    ["Rehabilitation and Physiotherapy","🏃",["Therapy Session","Patient Assessment","Therapy Plan","Exercise Type","Therapy Type","Therapy Plan Template","Patient Assessment Template"]],

    ["Nursing","👩‍⚕️",["Nursing Task","Healthcare Activity","Nursing Checklist Template"]],
    ["Laboratory","🔬",["Lab Test","Sample Collection"]],
    ["Service Units","🏨",["Healthcare Service Unit","Healthcare Service Unit Type"]],
    ["Terminology Mapping","🔤",["Code Value","Code System"]],
    ["Settings","⚙️",["Healthcare Settings","Patient History Settings"]],
    ["Consultation Setup","⚙️",["Appointment Type","Clinical Procedure Template","Treatment Plan Template","Dosage Form","Prescription Dosage","Prescription Duration","Complaint","Diagnosis"]],
    ["Laboratory Setup","⚙️",["Lab Test Template","Lab Test Sample","Lab Test UOM","Antibiotic","Sensitivity"]],
    ["Reports","📊",["Patient Appointment Analytics","Lab Test Report","Diagnosis Trends"]],
    ["Custom Reports","📋",["تقرير متابعة الجلسات"]]

  const arabicFallback={"Reports & Masters":"التقارير والبيانات الرئيسية","Masters":"البيانات الرئيسية","Consultation":"الاستشارة","Orders":"الطلبات","Inpatient":"التنويم","Rehabilitation and Physiotherapy":"التأهيل والعلاج الطبيعي","Diagnostic Module":"وحدة التشخيص","Nursing":"التمريض","Laboratory":"المختبر","Service Units":"وحدات الخدمة","Terminology Mapping":"تعيين المصطلحات","Settings":"الإعدادات","Consultation Setup":"إعداد الاستشارة","Laboratory Setup":"إعداد المختبر","Reports":"التقارير","Custom Reports":"تقارير مخصصة",
    "Patient":"المريض","Healthcare Practitioner":"الممارس الصحي","Practitioner Schedule":"جدول الممارس","Medical Department":"القسم الطبي","Patient Care Type":"نوع رعاية المريض",
    "Patient Appointment":"موعد المريض","Vital Signs":"العلامات الحيوية","Patient Encounter":"زيارة المريض","Clinical Procedure":"إجراء سريري","Fee Validity":"صلاحية الرسوم",

    "Nursing Task":"مهمة تمريضية","Healthcare Activity":"نشاط صحي","Nursing Checklist Template":"قالب قائمة التمريض",
    "Lab Test":"فحص مخبري","Sample Collection":"جمع العينات",
    "Healthcare Service Unit":"وحدة الخدمة الصحية","Healthcare Service Unit Type":"نوع وحدة الخدمة",

    "Healthcare Settings":"إعدادات الرعاية الصحية","Patient History Settings":"إعدادات تاريخ المريض",
    "Appointment Type":"نوع الموعد","Clinical Procedure Template":"قالب الإجراء السريري","Treatment Plan Template":"قالب خطة العلاج","Dosage Form":"شكل الجرعة","Prescription Dosage":"جرعة الوصفة","Prescription Duration":"مدة الوصفة","Complaint":"الشكوى","Diagnosis":"التشخيص",
    "Lab Test Template":"قالب الفحص المخبري","Lab Test Sample":"عينة الفحص","Lab Test UOM":"وحدة قياس الفحص","Antibiotic":"المضاد الحيوي","Sensitivity":"الحساسية",
    "Patient Appointment Analytics":"تحليلات مواعيد المرضى","Lab Test Report":"تقرير الفحوصات","Diagnosis Trends":"اتجاهات التشخيص","تقرير متابعة الجلسات":"تقرير متابعة الجلسات"};

  const singleDocs=new Set(["Healthcare Settings","Patient History Settings"]);
  const reportNames=new Set(["Patient Appointment Analytics","Lab Test Report","Diagnosis Trends","تقرير متابعة الجلسات"]);
  const treeDocs=new Set(["Healthcare Service Unit"]);

  const itemDescriptions={
    /* ── البيانات الرئيسية ── */
    "Patient":{icon:"🏥",summaryAr:"تسجيل بيانات المريض: الاسم، الجنس، تاريخ الميلاد، فصيلة الدم، بيانات الاتصال، والتاريخ الطبي.",summaryEn:"Register patient data: name, gender, DOB, blood group, contact info, and medical history.",stepsAr:["اضغط «مريض جديد»","أدخل الاسم والجنس وتاريخ الميلاد","حدد فصيلة الدم","أدخل رقم الهاتف والبريد","أضف التاريخ الطبي والحساسيات","اربطه بعميل للفوترة إن أردت","اضغط «حفظ»"],stepsEn:["Click «New Patient»","Enter name, gender, and DOB","Set blood group","Enter phone and email","Add medical history and allergies","Link to customer for billing if needed","Click «Save»"]},
    "Healthcare Practitioner":{icon:"👨‍⚕️",summaryAr:"تسجيل بيانات الممارس الصحي: الاسم، التخصص، رقم الترخيص، الجدول، ورسوم الاستشارة.",summaryEn:"Register practitioner data: name, specialty, license number, schedule, and consultation charges.",stepsAr:["اضغط «ممارس صحي جديد»","أدخل الاسم والتخصص","أدخل رقم الترخيص الطبي","حدد القسم الطبي","أدخل رسوم الاستشارة","حدد أوقات العمل","اربطه بموظف إن كان موظفاً","اضغط «حفظ»"],stepsEn:["Click «New Practitioner»","Enter name and specialty","Enter medical license number","Set medical department","Enter consultation charges","Set working hours","Link to employee if applicable","Click «Save»"]},
    "Practitioner Schedule":{icon:"📅",summaryAr:"تعريف جدول عمل الممارس: الأيام والأوقات المتاحة للمواعيد.",summaryEn:"Define practitioner schedule: available days and times for appointments.",stepsAr:["اضغط «جدول ممارس جديد»","أدخل اسم الجدول","أضف الفترات: اليوم ووقت البداية والنهاية","اضغط «حفظ»","اربطه بالممارس"],stepsEn:["Click «New Schedule»","Enter schedule name","Add time slots: day, start and end time","Click «Save»","Link to practitioner"]},
    "Medical Department":{icon:"🏢",summaryAr:"تعريف الأقسام الطبية (مثل: باطنية، جراحة، أطفال) لتصنيف الممارسين.",summaryEn:"Define medical departments (e.g., Internal Medicine, Surgery, Pediatrics) to classify practitioners.",stepsAr:["اضغط «قسم طبي جديد»","أدخل الاسم","أضف وصفاً","اضغط «حفظ»"],stepsEn:["Click «New Department»","Enter name","Add description","Click «Save»"]},
    "Patient Care Type":{icon:"💊",summaryAr:"تعريف أنواع رعاية المريض (مثل: عيادات خارجية، طوارئ، تنويم).",summaryEn:"Define patient care types (e.g., Outpatient, Emergency, Inpatient).",stepsAr:["اضغط «نوع رعاية جديد»","أدخل الاسم","اضغط «حفظ»"],stepsEn:["Click «New Care Type»","Enter name","Click «Save»"]},

    /* ── الاستشارة ── */
    "Patient Appointment":{icon:"📅",summaryAr:"حجز موعد لمريض مع ممارس صحي في وقت محدد مع نوع الموعد والرسوم.",summaryEn:"Book appointment for patient with practitioner at specific time with type and charges.",stepsAr:["اضغط «موعد مريض جديد»","اختر المريض","اختر الممارس الصحي ونوع الموعد","حدد التاريخ والوقت من الأوقات المتاحة","ستُحسب الرسوم تلقائياً","أضف ملاحظات إن أردت","اضغط «حفظ»"],stepsEn:["Click «New Appointment»","Select patient","Select practitioner and appointment type","Set date and time from available slots","Charges auto-calculate","Add notes if needed","Click «Save»"]},
    "Vital Signs":{icon:"❤️",summaryAr:"تسجيل العلامات الحيوية للمريض: الضغط، النبض، الحرارة، الوزن، الطول.",summaryEn:"Record patient vital signs: BP, pulse, temperature, weight, height.",stepsAr:["اضغط «علامات حيوية جديدة»","اختر المريض","أدخل الضغط (انقباضي/انبساطي) والنبض","أدخل الحرارة والوزن والطول","سيُحسب BMI تلقائياً","اضغط «حفظ»"],stepsEn:["Click «New Vital Signs»","Select patient","Enter BP (systolic/diastolic) and pulse","Enter temperature, weight, height","BMI auto-calculates","Click «Save»"]},
    "Patient Encounter":{icon:"🩺",summaryAr:"تسجيل زيارة المريض: الأعراض، التشخيص، الأدوية، الفحوصات المطلوبة، والإجراءات.",summaryEn:"Record patient encounter: symptoms, diagnosis, medications, lab orders, and procedures.",stepsAr:["اضغط «زيارة مريض جديدة»","اختر المريض والممارس","أدخل الشكوى والأعراض","أدخل التشخيص","أضف الأدوية الموصوفة","اطلب فحوصات مخبرية إن لزم","أضف إجراءات سريرية إن لزم","اضغط «حفظ» ثم «تسجيل»"],stepsEn:["Click «New Encounter»","Select patient and practitioner","Enter complaint and symptoms","Enter diagnosis","Add prescribed medications","Order lab tests if needed","Add clinical procedures if needed","Click «Save» then «Submit»"]},
    "Clinical Procedure":{icon:"💉",summaryAr:"تسجيل إجراء سريري للمريض (مثل: خياطة، حقن، تنظيف جرح) مع التفاصيل.",summaryEn:"Record clinical procedure (e.g., suturing, injection, wound cleaning) with details.",stepsAr:["اضغط «إجراء سريري جديد»","اختر المريض والممارس","اختر نوع الإجراء من القالب","حدد التاريخ والوقت","أضف ملاحظات الإجراء","أدخل المواد المستهلكة","اضغط «حفظ» ثم «تسجيل»"],stepsEn:["Click «New Procedure»","Select patient and practitioner","Select procedure type from template","Set date and time","Add procedure notes","Enter consumables used","Click «Save» then «Submit»"]},
    "Fee Validity":{icon:"💳",summaryAr:"صلاحية الرسوم: تحديد عدد الزيارات المجانية ضمن فترة بعد دفع رسوم الاستشارة.",summaryEn:"Fee validity: set number of free follow-up visits within a period after paying consultation fee.",stepsAr:["تُنشأ تلقائياً عند حجز الموعد","أو اضغط «صلاحية رسوم جديدة»","اختر المريض والممارس","حدد عدد الزيارات المسموحة","حدد تاريخ الصلاحية","اضغط «حفظ»"],stepsEn:["Auto-created on appointment booking","Or click «New Fee Validity»","Select patient and practitioner","Set allowed visit count","Set validity date","Click «Save»"]},

    /* ── الطلبات ── */
    "Service Request":{icon:"📋",summaryAr:"طلب خدمة طبية للمريض (فحص، إجراء، تحويل) من الزيارة.",summaryEn:"Medical service request for patient (test, procedure, referral) from encounter.",stepsAr:["يُنشأ تلقائياً من زيارة المريض أو اضغط «طلب خدمة جديد»","اختر المريض ونوع الخدمة","حدد الممارس المحوّل إليه","أضف التفاصيل","اضغط «حفظ» ثم «تسجيل»"],stepsEn:["Auto-created from encounter or click «New Service Request»","Select patient and service type","Set referring practitioner","Add details","Click «Save» then «Submit»"]},
    "Medication Request":{icon:"💊",summaryAr:"طلب دواء للمريض من الزيارة مع الجرعة والمدة والتكرار.",summaryEn:"Medication request for patient from encounter with dosage, duration, and frequency.",stepsAr:["يُنشأ تلقائياً من زيارة المريض أو اضغط «طلب دواء جديد»","اختر المريض والدواء","حدد الجرعة والتكرار والمدة","حدد شكل الجرعة","اضغط «حفظ» ثم «تسجيل»"],stepsEn:["Auto-created from encounter or click «New Medication Request»","Select patient and medication","Set dosage, frequency, and duration","Set dosage form","Click «Save» then «Submit»"]},

    /* ── التنويم ── */
    "Inpatient Record":{icon:"🛏️",summaryAr:"سجل تنويم المريض: القبول، السرير، القسم، الممارس المسؤول، وتاريخ الخروج.",summaryEn:"Inpatient record: admission, bed, department, attending practitioner, and discharge date.",stepsAr:["اضغط «سجل تنويم جديد»","اختر المريض","حدد نوع القبول والقسم","اختر السرير من وحدات الخدمة المتاحة","حدد الممارس المسؤول","أدخل تاريخ القبول","اضغط «حفظ» ثم «تسجيل»","عند الخروج: حدّث تاريخ الخروج"],stepsEn:["Click «New Inpatient Record»","Select patient","Set admission type and department","Select bed from available service units","Set attending practitioner","Enter admission date","Click «Save» then «Submit»","On discharge: update discharge date"]},
    "Inpatient Medication Order":{icon:"💊",summaryAr:"أمر أدوية للمريض المنوّم مع الجرعات والأوقات والممرض المسؤول.",summaryEn:"Medication order for inpatient with doses, times, and responsible nurse.",stepsAr:["اضغط «أمر أدوية جديد»","اختر المريض وسجل التنويم","أضف الأدوية مع الجرعات والتكرار","حدد وقت البدء","اضغط «حفظ» ثم «تسجيل»"],stepsEn:["Click «New Medication Order»","Select patient and inpatient record","Add medications with doses and frequency","Set start time","Click «Save» then «Submit»"]},
    "Inpatient Medication Entry":{icon:"📝",summaryAr:"تسجيل إعطاء الدواء الفعلي للمريض المنوّم مع الوقت والممرض.",summaryEn:"Record actual medication administration to inpatient with time and nurse.",stepsAr:["يُنشأ من أمر الأدوية أو اضغط «إدخال جديد»","اختر المريض والأمر","سجّل وقت الإعطاء","حدد الممرض المسؤول","أضف ملاحظات","اضغط «حفظ» ثم «تسجيل»"],stepsEn:["Created from medication order or click «New Entry»","Select patient and order","Record administration time","Set responsible nurse","Add notes","Click «Save» then «Submit»"]},

    /* ── التأهيل والعلاج الطبيعي ── */
    "Therapy Session":{icon:"🏃",summaryAr:"تسجيل جلسة علاج طبيعي للمريض مع التمارين والمدة والممارس.",summaryEn:"Record physiotherapy session with exercises, duration, and practitioner.",stepsAr:["اضغط «جلسة علاج جديدة»","اختر المريض والممارس","اختر خطة العلاج","أضف التمارين المنفذة","حدد المدة والتاريخ","أضف ملاحظات","اضغط «حفظ» ثم «تسجيل»"],stepsEn:["Click «New Therapy Session»","Select patient and practitioner","Select therapy plan","Add exercises performed","Set duration and date","Add notes","Click «Save» then «Submit»"]},
    "Patient Assessment":{icon:"📋",summaryAr:"تقييم حالة المريض باستخدام قالب تقييم محدد مع النتائج والدرجات.",summaryEn:"Assess patient condition using specific assessment template with results and scores.",stepsAr:["اضغط «تقييم مريض جديد»","اختر المريض والقالب","أدخل الإجابات/الدرجات لكل معيار","أضف ملاحظات","اضغط «حفظ» ثم «تسجيل»"],stepsEn:["Click «New Patient Assessment»","Select patient and template","Enter answers/scores per criterion","Add notes","Click «Save» then «Submit»"]},
    "Therapy Plan":{icon:"📋",summaryAr:"خطة علاج طبيعي للمريض: التمارين، عدد الجلسات، والمدة الزمنية.",summaryEn:"Physiotherapy plan for patient: exercises, number of sessions, and duration.",stepsAr:["اضغط «خطة علاج جديدة»","اختر المريض","اختر القالب أو أنشئ خطة مخصصة","أضف التمارين مع التكرار والمدة","حدد عدد الجلسات الإجمالي","اضغط «حفظ» ثم «تسجيل»"],stepsEn:["Click «New Therapy Plan»","Select patient","Select template or create custom plan","Add exercises with repetitions and duration","Set total number of sessions","Click «Save» then «Submit»"]},
    "Exercise Type":{icon:"💪",summaryAr:"تعريف أنواع التمارين المستخدمة في جلسات العلاج الطبيعي.",summaryEn:"Define exercise types used in physiotherapy sessions.",stepsAr:["اضغط «نوع تمرين جديد»","أدخل الاسم والوصف","أضف صورة توضيحية إن أردت","اضغط «حفظ»"],stepsEn:["Click «New Exercise Type»","Enter name and description","Add illustration image if needed","Click «Save»"]},
    "Therapy Type":{icon:"🏃",summaryAr:"تعريف أنواع العلاج الطبيعي (مثل: كهربائي، مائي، يدوي) مع الرسوم.",summaryEn:"Define therapy types (e.g., Electrical, Hydrotherapy, Manual) with charges.",stepsAr:["اضغط «نوع علاج جديد»","أدخل الاسم","أدخل رسوم الجلسة","حدد المدة الافتراضية","اضغط «حفظ»"],stepsEn:["Click «New Therapy Type»","Enter name","Enter session charges","Set default duration","Click «Save»"]},
    "Therapy Plan Template":{icon:"📋",summaryAr:"قالب خطة علاج جاهز لإعادة استخدامه مع التمارين والجلسات المحددة.",summaryEn:"Ready therapy plan template for reuse with predefined exercises and sessions.",stepsAr:["اضغط «قالب جديد»","أدخل الاسم","أضف التمارين والتكرار","حدد عدد الجلسات","اضغط «حفظ»"],stepsEn:["Click «New Template»","Enter name","Add exercises and repetitions","Set session count","Click «Save»"]},
    "Patient Assessment Template":{icon:"📋",summaryAr:"قالب تقييم مريض جاهز مع المعايير والدرجات لإعادة الاستخدام.",summaryEn:"Ready patient assessment template with criteria and scores for reuse.",stepsAr:["اضغط «قالب تقييم جديد»","أدخل الاسم","أضف معايير التقييم مع الدرجات","اضغط «حفظ»"],stepsEn:["Click «New Template»","Enter name","Add assessment criteria with scores","Click «Save»"]},

  function translate(n){if(!isArabic)return n;return arabicFallback[n]||(typeof window.__==="function"?window.__(n):n);}function escapeHtml(v){return String(v??"").replaceAll("&","&").replaceAll("<","<").replaceAll(">",">").replaceAll('"',""").replaceAll("'","'");}function formatNumber(n){return(parseFloat(n)||0).toLocaleString("en-US");}
  function showInfoModal(data){const title=isArabic?data.labelAr:data.labelEn,summary=isArabic?data.summaryAr:data.summaryEn,steps=isArabic?data.stepsAr:data.stepsEn,hasSteps=Array.isArray(steps)&&steps.length>0;const showT=isArabic?"📖 عرض الخطوات":"📖 Show Steps",hideT=isArabic?"📖 إخفاء الخطوات":"📖 Hide Steps";let stepsHtml=hasSteps?`<div class="erp-modal-steps" data-modal-steps><ol class="erp-modal-steps-list">${steps.map(s=>`<li>${escapeHtml(s)}</li>`).join("")}</ol></div>`:"";const overlay=document.createElement("div");overlay.className="erp-modal-overlay";overlay.setAttribute("dir",isArabic?"rtl":"ltr");overlay.innerHTML=`<div class="erp-modal-box"><button type="button" class="erp-modal-close" data-modal-close>✕</button><div class="erp-modal-header"><span class="erp-modal-icon">${data.icon}</span><h3 class="erp-modal-title">${escapeHtml(title)}</h3></div><p class="erp-modal-summary">${escapeHtml(summary)}</p>${hasSteps?`<button type="button" class="erp-modal-toggle-steps" data-toggle-steps>${showT}</button>`:""} ${stepsHtml}</div>`;root.appendChild(overlay);requestAnimationFrame(()=>overlay.classList.add("is-visible"));function closeModal(){overlay.classList.remove("is-visible");overlay.addEventListener("transitionend",()=>overlay.remove(),{once:true});}overlay.querySelector("[data-modal-close]").addEventListener("click",closeModal);overlay.addEventListener("click",e=>{if(e.target===overlay)closeModal();});const tb=overlay.querySelector("[data-toggle-steps]"),sc=overlay.querySelector("[data-modal-steps]");if(tb&&sc){tb.addEventListener("click",()=>{sc.classList.toggle("is-shown");tb.textContent=sc.classList.contains("is-shown")?hideT:showT;});}}

  function renderQuickActions(){if(!quickActions)return;quickActions.innerHTML=`<h2 class="erp-section-title">${escapeHtml(isArabic?"اختصارات سريعة":"Quick Actions")}</h2><div class="erp-quick-grid">${quickActionButtons.map(b=>`<button type="button" class="erp-quick-btn" data-new-doc="${escapeHtml(b.doctype)}" style="--btn-color:${b.color}"><span class="erp-quick-icon">${b.icon}</span><span class="erp-quick-label">${escapeHtml(isArabic?b.labelAr:b.labelEn)}</span></button>`).join("")}</div>`;quickActions.addEventListener("click",e=>{const b=e.target.closest("[data-new-doc]");if(!b||!window.frappe)return;if(typeof frappe.new_doc==="function")frappe.new_doc(b.dataset.newDoc);});}
  function renderSections(){root.setAttribute("dir",isArabic?"rtl":"ltr");root.classList.toggle("erp-dashboard-rtl",isArabic);content.innerHTML=sections.map((s,si)=>{const ch=s[1].map((c,ci)=>{const lh=c[2].map(i=>{const d=itemDescriptions[i],dl=isArabic?"تفاصيل":"Details",ib=d?`<button type="button" class="erp-info-link" data-info-item="${escapeHtml(i)}">${dl}</button>`:"";return`<div class="erp-link-row"><button type="button" class="erp-link" data-route-name="${escapeHtml(i)}"><span class="erp-link-text">${escapeHtml(translate(i))}</span><span class="erp-link-arrow">${isArabic?"←":"→"}</span></button>${ib}</div>`;}).join("");return`<article class="erp-card tone-${(si+ci)%5}" data-erp-card><button type="button" class="erp-card-heading" data-card-toggle aria-expanded="false"><span class="erp-icon">${c[1]}</span><span class="erp-card-title">${escapeHtml(translate(c[0]))}</span><span class="erp-card-chevron">⌄</span></button><div class="erp-card-links">${lh}</div></article>`;}).join("");return`<section class="erp-module-section"><h2 class="erp-section-title">${escapeHtml(translate(s[0]))}</h2><div class="erp-dashboard-grid">${ch}</div></section>`;}).join("");}
  function renderFooter(){if(!footerEl)return;const l=footerInfo.labels,p=isArabic?l.phoneAr:l.phoneEn,e=isArabic?l.emailAr:l.emailEn,w=isArabic?l.websiteAr:l.websiteEn;footerEl.innerHTML=`<div class="erp-footer-inner"><div class="erp-footer-item"><span class="erp-footer-icon">📞</span><span class="erp-footer-label">${escapeHtml(p)}:</span><a href="tel:${footerInfo.phone}" class="erp-footer-link" dir="ltr">${escapeHtml(footerInfo.phone)}</a></div><span class="erp-footer-sep">|</span><div class="erp-footer-item"><span class="erp-footer-icon">✉️</span><span class="erp-footer-label">${escapeHtml(e)}:</span><a href="mailto:${footerInfo.email}" class="erp-footer-link">${escapeHtml(footerInfo.email)}</a></div><span class="erp-footer-sep">|</span><div class="erp-footer-item"><span class="erp-footer-icon">🌐</span><span class="erp-footer-label">${escapeHtml(w)}:</span><a href="https://${footerInfo.website}" class="erp-footer-link" target="_blank" rel="noopener">${escapeHtml(footerInfo.website)}</a></div></div>`;}
  function openRoute(n){if(!window.frappe||typeof frappe.set_route!=="function")return;if(reportNames.has(n)){frappe.set_route("query-report",n);return;}if(singleDocs.has(n)){frappe.set_route("Form",n);return;}if(treeDocs.has(n)){frappe.set_route("Tree",n);return;}frappe.set_route("List",n);}
  let lastToggleTime=0;content.addEventListener("click",event=>{const ib=event.target.closest("[data-info-item]");if(ib){event.preventDefault();event.stopPropagation();const d=itemDescriptions[ib.dataset.infoItem];if(d)showInfoModal({icon:d.icon||"📄",labelAr:translate(ib.dataset.infoItem),labelEn:ib.dataset.infoItem,summaryAr:d.summaryAr,summaryEn:d.summaryEn,stepsAr:d.stepsAr,stepsEn:d.stepsEn});return;}const rb=event.target.closest("[data-route-name]");if(rb){event.preventDefault();event.stopPropagation();openRoute(rb.dataset.routeName);return;}const cb=event.target.closest("[data-card-toggle]");if(!cb)return;const now=Date.now();if(now-lastToggleTime<400)return;lastToggleTime=now;const sc=cb.closest("[data-erp-card]");if(!sc)return;const so=!sc.classList.contains("is-open");content.querySelectorAll("[data-erp-card]").forEach(c=>{if(c!==sc){c.classList.remove("is-open");c.querySelector("[data-card-toggle]")?.setAttribute("aria-expanded","false");}});if(so){sc.classList.add("is-open");cb.setAttribute("aria-expanded","true");}else{sc.classList.remove("is-open");cb.setAttribute("aria-expanded","false");}});

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════

  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  function translate(n){if(!isArabic)return n;return arabicFallback[n]||(typeof window.__==="function"?window.__(n):n);}
  function escapeHtml(v){return String(v??"").replaceAll("&","&").replaceAll("<","<").replaceAll(">",">").replaceAll('"',""").replaceAll("'","'");}
  function formatNumber(n){return(parseFloat(n)||0).toLocaleString("en-US");}

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
     نافذة التوضيح المنبثقة
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  function showInfoModal(data){
    const title=isArabic?data.labelAr:data.labelEn;
    const summary=isArabic?data.summaryAr:data.summaryEn;
    const steps=isArabic?data.stepsAr:data.stepsEn;
    const hasSteps=Array.isArray(steps)&&steps.length>0;
    const showT=isArabic?"📖 عرض الخطوات":"📖 Show Steps";
    const hideT=isArabic?"📖 إخفاء الخطوات":"📖 Hide Steps";
    let stepsHtml=hasSteps?`<div class="erp-modal-steps" data-modal-steps><ol class="erp-modal-steps-list">${steps.map(s=>`<li>${escapeHtml(s)}</li>`).join("")}</ol></div>`:"";
    const overlay=document.createElement("div");
    overlay.className="erp-modal-overlay";
    overlay.setAttribute("dir",isArabic?"rtl":"ltr");
    overlay.innerHTML=`<div class="erp-modal-box"><button type="button" class="erp-modal-close" data-modal-close>✕</button><div class="erp-modal-header"><span class="erp-modal-icon">${data.icon}</span><h3 class="erp-modal-title">${escapeHtml(title)}</h3></div><p class="erp-modal-summary">${escapeHtml(summary)}</p>${hasSteps?`<button type="button" class="erp-modal-toggle-steps" data-toggle-steps>${showT}</button>`:""} ${stepsHtml}</div>`;
    root.appendChild(overlay);
    requestAnimationFrame(()=>overlay.classList.add("is-visible"));
    function closeModal(){overlay.classList.remove("is-visible");overlay.addEventListener("transitionend",()=>overlay.remove(),{once:true});}
    overlay.querySelector("[data-modal-close]").addEventListener("click",closeModal);
    overlay.addEventListener("click",e=>{if(e.target===overlay)closeModal();});
    const tb=overlay.querySelector("[data-toggle-steps]"),sc=overlay.querySelector("[data-modal-steps]");
    if(tb&&sc){tb.addEventListener("click",()=>{sc.classList.toggle("is-shown");tb.textContent=sc.classList.contains("is-shown")?hideT:showT;});}
  }

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
     عرض البطاقات الإحصائية
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  function renderStats(){
    if(!statsSection)return;
    statsSection.innerHTML=`<div class="erp-stats-grid">${statsCards.map(c=>
      `<div class="erp-stat-card" style="--stat-color:${c.color}">
        <div class="erp-stat-icon">${c.icon}</div>
        <div class="erp-stat-info">
          <span class="erp-stat-value" data-stat-id="${c.id}">...</span>
          <span class="erp-stat-label">${escapeHtml(isArabic?c.labelAr:c.labelEn)}</span>
        </div>
      </div>`).join("")}</div>`;
    if(window.frappe)statsCards.forEach(c=>c.fetch().then(v=>{
      const el=statsSection.querySelector(`[data-stat-id="${c.id}"]`);
      if(el)el.textContent=formatNumber(v);
    }));
  }

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
     عرض الاختصارات السريعة
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  function renderQuickActions(){
    if(!quickActions)return;
    quickActions.innerHTML=`<h2 class="erp-section-title">${escapeHtml(isArabic?"اختصارات سريعة":"Quick Actions")}</h2>
    <div class="erp-quick-grid">${quickActionButtons.map(b=>
      `<button type="button" class="erp-quick-btn" data-new-doc="${escapeHtml(b.doctype)}" style="--btn-color:${b.color}">
        <span class="erp-quick-icon">${b.icon}</span>
        <span class="erp-quick-label">${escapeHtml(isArabic?b.labelAr:b.labelEn)}</span>
      </button>`).join("")}</div>`;
    quickActions.addEventListener("click",e=>{
      const b=e.target.closest("[data-new-doc]");
      if(!b||!window.frappe)return;
      if(specialPages[b.dataset.newDoc]){frappe.set_route(specialPages[b.dataset.newDoc]);return;}
      frappe.set_route("List",b.dataset.newDoc);
    });
  }

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
     عرض أقسام البطاقات
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  function renderSections(){
    root.setAttribute("dir",isArabic?"rtl":"ltr");
    root.classList.toggle("erp-dashboard-rtl",isArabic);
    content.innerHTML=sections.map((s,si)=>{
      const ch=s[1].map((c,ci)=>{
        const lh=c[2].map(i=>{
          const d=itemDescriptions[i];
          const dl=isArabic?"تفاصيل":"Details";
          const ib=d?`<button type="button" class="erp-info-link" data-info-item="${escapeHtml(i)}">${dl}</button>`:"";
          return`<div class="erp-link-row">
            <button type="button" class="erp-link" data-route-name="${escapeHtml(i)}">
              <span class="erp-link-text">${escapeHtml(translate(i))}</span>
              <span class="erp-link-arrow">${isArabic?"←":"→"}</span>
            </button>${ib}</div>`;
        }).join("");
        return`<article class="erp-card tone-${(si+ci)%5}" data-erp-card>
          <button type="button" class="erp-card-heading" data-card-toggle aria-expanded="false">
            <span class="erp-icon">${c[1]}</span>
            <span class="erp-card-title">${escapeHtml(translate(c[0]))}</span>
            <span class="erp-card-chevron">⌄</span>
          </button>
          <div class="erp-card-links">${lh}</div>
        </article>`;
      }).join("");
      return`<section class="erp-module-section">
        <h2 class="erp-section-title">${escapeHtml(translate(s[0]))}</h2>
        <div class="erp-dashboard-grid">${ch}</div>
      </section>`;
    }).join("");
  }

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
     عرض التذييل
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  function renderFooter(){
    if(!footerEl)return;
    const l=footerInfo.labels,p=isArabic?l.phoneAr:l.phoneEn,e=isArabic?l.emailAr:l.emailEn,w=isArabic?l.websiteAr:l.websiteEn;
    footerEl.innerHTML=`<div class="erp-footer-inner">
      <div class="erp-footer-item"><span class="erp-footer-icon">📞</span><span class="erp-footer-label">${escapeHtml(p)}:</span><a href="tel:${footerInfo.phone}" class="erp-footer-link" dir="ltr">${escapeHtml(footerInfo.phone)}</a></div>
      <span class="erp-footer-sep">|</span>
      <div class="erp-footer-item"><span class="erp-footer-icon">✉️</span><span class="erp-footer-label">${escapeHtml(e)}:</span><a href="mailto:${footerInfo.email}" class="erp-footer-link">${escapeHtml(footerInfo.email)}</a></div>
      <span class="erp-footer-sep">|</span>
      <div class="erp-footer-item"><span class="erp-footer-icon">🌐</span><span class="erp-footer-label">${escapeHtml(w)}:</span><a href="https://${footerInfo.website}" class="erp-footer-link" target="_blank" rel="noopener">${escapeHtml(footerInfo.website)}</a></div>
    </div>`;
  }

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
     التوجيه
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  function openRoute(n){
    if(!window.frappe||typeof frappe.set_route!=="function")return;
    if(specialPages[n]){frappe.set_route(specialPages[n]);return;}
    if(singleDocs.has(n)){frappe.set_route("Form",n);return;}
    frappe.set_route("List",n);
  }

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
     تفويض الأحداث
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  let lastToggleTime=0;
  content.addEventListener("click",event=>{
    const ib=event.target.closest("[data-info-item]");
    if(ib){
      event.preventDefault();event.stopPropagation();
      const d=itemDescriptions[ib.dataset.infoItem];
      if(d)showInfoModal({icon:d.icon||"📄",labelAr:translate(ib.dataset.infoItem),labelEn:ib.dataset.infoItem,summaryAr:d.summaryAr,summaryEn:d.summaryEn,stepsAr:d.stepsAr,stepsEn:d.stepsEn});
      return;
    }
    const rb=event.target.closest("[data-route-name]");
    if(rb){event.preventDefault();event.stopPropagation();openRoute(rb.dataset.routeName);return;}
    const cb=event.target.closest("[data-card-toggle]");
    if(!cb)return;
    const now=Date.now();
    if(now-lastToggleTime<400)return;
    lastToggleTime=now;
    const sc=cb.closest("[data-erp-card]");
    if(!sc)return;
    const so=!sc.classList.contains("is-open");
    content.querySelectorAll("[data-erp-card]").forEach(c=>{
      if(c!==sc){c.classList.remove("is-open");c.querySelector("[data-card-toggle]")?.setAttribute("aria-expanded","false");}
    });
    if(so){sc.classList.add("is-open");cb.setAttribute("aria-expanded","true");}
    else{sc.classList.remove("is-open");cb.setAttribute("aria-expanded","false");}
  });

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
     تشغيل اللوحة
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  renderStats();renderQuickActions();renderSections();renderFooter();
})();

  /* ── دوال مساعدة ── */
  function translate(n) { if (!isArabic) return n; return arabicFallback[n] || (typeof window.__ === "function" ? window.__(n) : n); }
  function escapeHtml(v) { return String(v ?? "").replaceAll("&","&").replaceAll("<","<").replaceAll(">",">").replaceAll('"',""").replaceAll("'","'"); }
  function formatNumber(n) { return (parseFloat(n) || 0).toLocaleString("en-US"); }

  /* ── Modal ── */
  function showInfoModal(data) {
    const title = isArabic ? data.labelAr : data.labelEn;
    const summary = isArabic ? data.summaryAr : data.summaryEn;
    const steps = isArabic ? data.stepsAr : data.stepsEn;
    const hasSteps = Array.isArray(steps) && steps.length > 0;
    const showT = isArabic ? "📖 عرض الخطوات" : "📖 Show Steps";
    const hideT = isArabic ? "📖 إخفاء الخطوات" : "📖 Hide Steps";
    let stepsHtml = hasSteps ? `<div class="erp-modal-steps" data-modal-steps><ol class="erp-modal-steps-list">${steps.map(s=>`<li>${escapeHtml(s)}</li>`).join("")}</ol></div>` : "";

    const overlay = document.createElement("div");
    overlay.className = "erp-modal-overlay";
    overlay.setAttribute("dir", isArabic ? "rtl" : "ltr");
    overlay.innerHTML = `<div class="erp-modal-box"><button type="button" class="erp-modal-close" data-modal-close>✕</button><div class="erp-modal-header"><span class="erp-modal-icon">${data.icon}</span><h3 class="erp-modal-title">${escapeHtml(title)}</h3></div><p class="erp-modal-summary">${escapeHtml(summary)}</p>${hasSteps?`<button type="button" class="erp-modal-toggle-steps" data-toggle-steps>${showT}</button>`:""} ${stepsHtml}</div>`;
    root.appendChild(overlay);
    requestAnimationFrame(() => overlay.classList.add("is-visible"));
    function closeModal() { overlay.classList.remove("is-visible"); overlay.addEventListener("transitionend", () => overlay.remove(), { once: true }); }
    overlay.querySelector("[data-modal-close]").addEventListener("click", closeModal);
    overlay.addEventListener("click", (e) => { if (e.target === overlay) closeModal(); });
    const tb = overlay.querySelector("[data-toggle-steps]"), sc = overlay.querySelector("[data-modal-steps]");
    if (tb && sc) { tb.addEventListener("click", () => { sc.classList.toggle("is-shown"); tb.textContent = sc.classList.contains("is-shown") ? hideT : showT; }); }
  }

  /* ── إحصائيات ── */
  function renderStats() {
    if (!statsSection) return;
    statsSection.innerHTML = `<div class="erp-stats-grid">${statsCards.map(c => `<div class="erp-stat-card" style="--stat-color:${c.color}"><div class="erp-stat-icon">${c.icon}</div><div class="erp-stat-info"><span class="erp-stat-value" data-stat-id="${c.id}">...</span><span class="erp-stat-label">${escapeHtml(isArabic?c.labelAr:c.labelEn)}</span></div></div>`).join("")}</div>`;
    if (window.frappe) statsCards.forEach(c => c.fetch().then(v => { const el = statsSection.querySelector(`[data-stat-id="${c.id}"]`); if (el) el.textContent = formatNumber(v); }));
  }

  /* ── اختصارات ── */
  function renderQuickActions() {
    if (!quickActions) return;
    quickActions.innerHTML = `<h2 class="erp-section-title">${escapeHtml(isArabic?"اختصارات سريعة":"Quick Actions")}</h2><div class="erp-quick-grid">${quickActionButtons.map(b=>`<button type="button" class="erp-quick-btn" data-new-doc="${escapeHtml(b.doctype)}" ${b.isReport?'data-is-report="1"':""} style="--btn-color:${b.color}"><span class="erp-quick-icon">${b.icon}</span><span class="erp-quick-label">${escapeHtml(isArabic?b.labelAr:b.labelEn)}</span></button>`).join("")}</div>`;
    quickActions.addEventListener("click", (e) => { const b = e.target.closest("[data-new-doc]"); if (!b||!window.frappe) return; if (b.dataset.isReport==="1") { frappe.set_route("query-report",b.dataset.newDoc); return; } if (typeof frappe.new_doc==="function") frappe.new_doc(b.dataset.newDoc); });
  }

  /* ── بطاقات ── */
  function renderSections() {
    root.setAttribute("dir", isArabic?"rtl":"ltr"); root.classList.toggle("erp-dashboard-rtl", isArabic);
    content.innerHTML = sections.map((s,si) => { const ch = s[1].map((c,ci) => { const lh = c[2].map(i => { const d=itemDescriptions[i], dl=isArabic?"تفاصيل":"Details", ib=d?`<button type="button" class="erp-info-link" data-info-item="${escapeHtml(i)}">${dl}</button>`:""; return `<div class="erp-link-row"><button type="button" class="erp-link" data-route-name="${escapeHtml(i)}"><span class="erp-link-text">${escapeHtml(translate(i))}</span><span class="erp-link-arrow">${isArabic?"←":"→"}</span></button>${ib}</div>`; }).join(""); return `<article class="erp-card tone-${(si+ci)%5}" data-erp-card><button type="button" class="erp-card-heading" data-card-toggle aria-expanded="false"><span class="erp-icon">${c[1]}</span><span class="erp-card-title">${escapeHtml(translate(c[0]))}</span><span class="erp-card-chevron">⌄</span></button><div class="erp-card-links">${lh}</div></article>`; }).join(""); return `<section class="erp-module-section"><h2 class="erp-section-title">${escapeHtml(translate(s[0]))}</h2><div class="erp-dashboard-grid">${ch}</div></section>`; }).join("");
  }

  /* ── فوتر ── */
  function renderFooter() {
    if (!footerEl) return; const l=footerInfo.labels, p=isArabic?l.phoneAr:l.phoneEn, e=isArabic?l.emailAr:l.emailEn, w=isArabic?l.websiteAr:l.websiteEn;
    footerEl.innerHTML = `<div class="erp-footer-inner"><div class="erp-footer-item"><span class="erp-footer-icon">📞</span><span class="erp-footer-label">${escapeHtml(p)}:</span><a href="tel:${footerInfo.phone}" class="erp-footer-link" dir="ltr">${escapeHtml(footerInfo.phone)}</a></div><span class="erp-footer-sep">|</span><div class="erp-footer-item"><span class="erp-footer-icon">✉️</span><span class="erp-footer-label">${escapeHtml(e)}:</span><a href="mailto:${footerInfo.email}" class="erp-footer-link">${escapeHtml(footerInfo.email)}</a></div><span class="erp-footer-sep">|</span><div class="erp-footer-item"><span class="erp-footer-icon">🌐</span><span class="erp-footer-label">${escapeHtml(w)}:</span><a href="https://${footerInfo.website}" class="erp-footer-link" target="_blank" rel="noopener">${escapeHtml(footerInfo.website)}</a></div></div>`;
  }

  /* ── فتح ── */
  function openRoute(n) { if (!window.frappe||typeof frappe.set_route!=="function") return; if (reportNames.has(n)){frappe.set_route("query-report",n);return;} if(singleDocs.has(n)){frappe.set_route("Form",n);return;} frappe.set_route("List",n); }

  /* ── أحداث ── */
  let lastToggleTime = 0;
  content.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
    const ib=event.target.closest("[data-info-item]"); if(ib){event.preventDefault();event.stopPropagation();const d=itemDescriptions[ib.dataset.infoItem];if(d)showInfoModal({icon:d.icon||"📄",labelAr:translate(ib.dataset.infoItem),labelEn:ib.dataset.infoItem,summaryAr:d.summaryAr,summaryEn:d.summaryEn,stepsAr:d.stepsAr,stepsEn:d.stepsEn});return;}
    const rb=event.target.closest("[data-route-name]");if(rb){event.preventDefault();event.stopPropagation();openRoute(rb.dataset.routeName);return;}
    const cb=event.target.closest("[data-card-toggle]");if(!cb)return;const now=Date.now();if(now-lastToggleTime<400)return;lastToggleTime=now;
    const sc=cb.closest("[data-erp-card]");if(!sc)return;const so=!sc.classList.contains("is-open");
    content.querySelectorAll("[data-erp-card]").forEach(c=>{if(c!==sc){c.classList.remove("is-open");c.querySelector("[data-card-toggle]")?.setAttribute("aria-expanded","false");}});
    if(so){sc.classList.add("is-open");cb.setAttribute("aria-expanded","true");}else{sc.classList.remove("is-open");cb.setAttribute("aria-expanded","false");}
  });

  /* ── تشغيل ── */
  renderStats(); renderQuickActions(); renderSections(); renderFooter();
})();

      stepsAr:["اضغط «مساهم جديد»","أدخل اسم المساهم","أدخل بيانات الاتصال والعنوان","سيُحدّث عدد الأسهم تلقائياً من عمليات التحويل","اضغط «حفظ»"],
      stepsEn:["Click «New Shareholder»","Enter shareholder name","Add contact and address details","Share count updates automatically from transfers","Click «Save»"]},

    "Share Transfer":{ icon:"🔀",
      summaryAr:"تسجيل عمليات نقل ملكية الأسهم بين المساهمين أو إصدار أسهم جديدة أو شراء أسهم.",
      summaryEn:"Record share ownership transfers between shareholders, new share issues, or share purchases.",
      stepsAr:["اضغط «تحويل أسهم جديد»","اختر نوع التحويل (نقل، إصدار، شراء)","حدد المساهم المصدر والمساهم المستلم","أدخل عدد الأسهم وسعر السهم","حدد تاريخ التحويل","اضغط «حفظ» ثم «تسجيل»"],
      stepsEn:["Click «New Share Transfer»","Select transfer type (Transfer, Issue, Purchase)","Set from and to shareholder","Enter share count and rate per share","Set transfer date","Click «Save» then «Submit»"]}
  };

  function translate(n){if(!isArabic)return n;return arabicFallback[n]||(typeof window.__==="function"?window.__(n):n);}
  function escapeHtml(v){return String(v??"").replaceAll("&","&").replaceAll("<","<").replaceAll(">",">").replaceAll('"',""").replaceAll("'","'");}
  function formatNumber(n){return(parseFloat(n)||0).toLocaleString("en-US");}

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
     Modal (نافذة التوضيح)
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  function showInfoModal(data){const title=isArabic?data.labelAr:data.labelEn,summary=isArabic?data.summaryAr:data.summaryEn,steps=isArabic?data.stepsAr:data.stepsEn,hasSteps=Array.isArray(steps)&&steps.length>0;const showT=isArabic?"📖 عرض الخطوات":"📖 Show Steps",hideT=isArabic?"📖 إخفاء الخطوات":"📖 Hide Steps";let stepsHtml=hasSteps?`<div class="erp-modal-steps" data-modal-steps><ol class="erp-modal-steps-list">${steps.map(s=>`<li>${escapeHtml(s)}</li>`).join("")}</ol></div>`:"";const overlay=document.createElement("div");overlay.className="erp-modal-overlay";overlay.setAttribute("dir",isArabic?"rtl":"ltr");overlay.innerHTML=`<div class="erp-modal-box"><button type="button" class="erp-modal-close" data-modal-close>✕</button><div class="erp-modal-header"><span class="erp-modal-icon">${data.icon}</span><h3 class="erp-modal-title">${escapeHtml(title)}</h3></div><p class="erp-modal-summary">${escapeHtml(summary)}</p>${hasSteps?`<button type="button" class="erp-modal-toggle-steps" data-toggle-steps>${showT}</button>`:""} ${stepsHtml}</div>`;root.appendChild(overlay);requestAnimationFrame(()=>overlay.classList.add("is-visible"));function closeModal(){overlay.classList.remove("is-visible");overlay.addEventListener("transitionend",()=>overlay.remove(),{once:true});}overlay.querySelector("[data-modal-close]").addEventListener("click",closeModal);overlay.addEventListener("click",e=>{if(e.target===overlay)closeModal();});const tb=overlay.querySelector("[data-toggle-steps]"),sc=overlay.querySelector("[data-modal-steps]");if(tb&&sc){tb.addEventListener("click",()=>{sc.classList.toggle("is-shown");tb.textContent=sc.classList.contains("is-shown")?hideT:showT;});}}

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
     Render Functions
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  function renderStats(){if(!statsSection)return;statsSection.innerHTML=`<div class="erp-stats-grid">${statsCards.map(c=>`<div class="erp-stat-card" style="--stat-color:${c.color}"><div class="erp-stat-icon">${c.icon}</div><div class="erp-stat-info"><span class="erp-stat-value" data-stat-id="${c.id}">...</span><span class="erp-stat-label">${escapeHtml(isArabic?c.labelAr:c.labelEn)}</span></div></div>`).join("")}</div>`;if(window.frappe)statsCards.forEach(c=>c.fetch().then(v=>{const el=statsSection.querySelector(`[data-stat-id="${c.id}"]`);if(el)el.textContent=formatNumber(v);}));}

  function renderQuickActions(){if(!quickActions)return;quickActions.innerHTML=`<h2 class="erp-section-title">${escapeHtml(isArabic?"اختصارات سريعة":"Quick Actions")}</h2><div class="erp-quick-grid">${quickActionButtons.map(b=>`<button type="button" class="erp-quick-btn" data-new-doc="${escapeHtml(b.doctype)}" ${b.isReport?'data-is-report="1"':""} ${b.isTree?'data-is-tree="1"':""} style="--btn-color:${b.color}"><span class="erp-quick-icon">${b.icon}</span><span class="erp-quick-label">${escapeHtml(isArabic?b.labelAr:b.labelEn)}</span></button>`).join("")}</div>`;quickActions.addEventListener("click",e=>{const b=e.target.closest("[data-new-doc]");if(!b||!window.frappe)return;if(b.dataset.isReport==="1"){frappe.set_route("query-report",b.dataset.newDoc);return;}if(b.dataset.isTree==="1"){frappe.set_route("Tree","Account");return;}if(typeof frappe.new_doc==="function")frappe.new_doc(b.dataset.newDoc);});}

  function renderSections(){root.setAttribute("dir",isArabic?"rtl":"ltr");root.classList.toggle("erp-dashboard-rtl",isArabic);content.innerHTML=sections.map((s,si)=>{const ch=s[1].map((c,ci)=>{const lh=c[2].map(i=>{const d=itemDescriptions[i],dl=isArabic?"تفاصيل":"Details",ib=d?`<button type="button" class="erp-info-link" data-info-item="${escapeHtml(i)}">${dl}</button>`:"";return`<div class="erp-link-row"><button type="button" class="erp-link" data-route-name="${escapeHtml(i)}"><span class="erp-link-text">${escapeHtml(translate(i))}</span><span class="erp-link-arrow">${isArabic?"←":"→"}</span></button>${ib}</div>`;}).join("");return`<article class="erp-card tone-${(si+ci)%5}" data-erp-card><button type="button" class="erp-card-heading" data-card-toggle aria-expanded="false"><span class="erp-icon">${c[1]}</span><span class="erp-card-title">${escapeHtml(translate(c[0]))}</span><span class="erp-card-chevron">⌄</span></button><div class="erp-card-links">${lh}</div></article>`;}).join("");return`<section class="erp-module-section"><h2 class="erp-section-title">${escapeHtml(translate(s[0]))}</h2><div class="erp-dashboard-grid">${ch}</div></section>`;}).join("");}

  function renderFooter(){if(!footerEl)return;const l=footerInfo.labels,p=isArabic?l.phoneAr:l.phoneEn,e=isArabic?l.emailAr:l.emailEn,w=isArabic?l.websiteAr:l.websiteEn;footerEl.innerHTML=`<div class="erp-footer-inner"><div class="erp-footer-item"><span class="erp-footer-icon">📞</span><span class="erp-footer-label">${escapeHtml(p)}:</span><a href="tel:${footerInfo.phone}" class="erp-footer-link" dir="ltr">${escapeHtml(footerInfo.phone)}</a></div><span class="erp-footer-sep">|</span><div class="erp-footer-item"><span class="erp-footer-icon">✉️</span><span class="erp-footer-label">${escapeHtml(e)}:</span><a href="mailto:${footerInfo.email}" class="erp-footer-link">${escapeHtml(footerInfo.email)}</a></div><span class="erp-footer-sep">|</span><div class="erp-footer-item"><span class="erp-footer-icon">🌐</span><span class="erp-footer-label">${escapeHtml(w)}:</span><a href="https://${footerInfo.website}" class="erp-footer-link" target="_blank" rel="noopener">${escapeHtml(footerInfo.website)}</a></div></div>`;}

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
     Routing
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  function openRoute(n){if(!window.frappe||typeof frappe.set_route!=="function")return;if(reportNames.has(n)){frappe.set_route("query-report",n);return;}if(singleDocs.has(n)){frappe.set_route("Form",n);return;}if(treeDocs.has(n)){const treeMap={"Chart of Accounts":"Account","Chart of Cost Centers":"Cost Center"};frappe.set_route("Tree",treeMap[n]||n);return;}frappe.set_route("List",n);}

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
     Event Delegation
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  let lastToggleTime=0;
  content.addEventListener("click",event=>{const ib=event.target.closest("[data-info-item]");if(ib){event.preventDefault();event.stopPropagation();const d=itemDescriptions[ib.dataset.infoItem];if(d)showInfoModal({icon:d.icon||"📄",labelAr:translate(ib.dataset.infoItem),labelEn:ib.dataset.infoItem,summaryAr:d.summaryAr,summaryEn:d.summaryEn,stepsAr:d.stepsAr,stepsEn:d.stepsEn});return;}const rb=event.target.closest("[data-route-name]");if(rb){event.preventDefault();event.stopPropagation();openRoute(rb.dataset.routeName);return;}const cb=event.target.closest("[data-card-toggle]");if(!cb)return;const now=Date.now();if(now-lastToggleTime<400)return;lastToggleTime=now;const sc=cb.closest("[data-erp-card]");if(!sc)return;const so=!sc.classList.contains("is-open");content.querySelectorAll("[data-erp-card]").forEach(c=>{if(c!==sc){c.classList.remove("is-open");c.querySelector("[data-card-toggle]")?.setAttribute("aria-expanded","false");}});if(so){sc.classList.add("is-open");cb.setAttribute("aria-expanded","true");}else{sc.classList.remove("is-open");cb.setAttribute("aria-expanded","false");}});

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
     Init
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  renderStats();renderQuickActions();renderSections();renderFooter();
})();

  function translate(n){if(!isArabic)return n;return arabicFallback[n]||(typeof window.__==="function"?window.__(n):n);}
  function escapeHtml(v){return String(v??"").replaceAll("&","&").replaceAll("<","<").replaceAll(">",">").replaceAll('"',""").replaceAll("'","'");}
  function formatNumber(n){return(parseFloat(n)||0).toLocaleString("en-US");}

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
     Modal
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  function showInfoModal(data){const title=isArabic?data.labelAr:data.labelEn,summary=isArabic?data.summaryAr:data.summaryEn,steps=isArabic?data.stepsAr:data.stepsEn,hasSteps=Array.isArray(steps)&&steps.length>0;const showT=isArabic?"📖 عرض الخطوات":"📖 Show Steps",hideT=isArabic?"📖 إخفاء الخطوات":"📖 Hide Steps";let stepsHtml=hasSteps?`<div class="erp-modal-steps" data-modal-steps><ol class="erp-modal-steps-list">${steps.map(s=>`<li>${escapeHtml(s)}</li>`).join("")}</ol></div>`:"";const overlay=document.createElement("div");overlay.className="erp-modal-overlay";overlay.setAttribute("dir",isArabic?"rtl":"ltr");overlay.innerHTML=`<div class="erp-modal-box"><button type="button" class="erp-modal-close" data-modal-close>✕</button><div class="erp-modal-header"><span class="erp-modal-icon">${data.icon}</span><h3 class="erp-modal-title">${escapeHtml(title)}</h3></div><p class="erp-modal-summary">${escapeHtml(summary)}</p>${hasSteps?`<button type="button" class="erp-modal-toggle-steps" data-toggle-steps>${showT}</button>`:""} ${stepsHtml}</div>`;root.appendChild(overlay);requestAnimationFrame(()=>overlay.classList.add("is-visible"));function closeModal(){overlay.classList.remove("is-visible");overlay.addEventListener("transitionend",()=>overlay.remove(),{once:true});}overlay.querySelector("[data-modal-close]").addEventListener("click",closeModal);overlay.addEventListener("click",e=>{if(e.target===overlay)closeModal();});const tb=overlay.querySelector("[data-toggle-steps]"),sc=overlay.querySelector("[data-modal-steps]");if(tb&&sc){tb.addEventListener("click",()=>{sc.classList.toggle("is-shown");tb.textContent=sc.classList.contains("is-shown")?hideT:showT;});}}

     Render

  function renderStats(){if(!statsSection)return;statsSection.innerHTML=`<div class="erp-stats-grid">${statsCards.map(c=>`<div class="erp-stat-card" style="--stat-color:${c.color}"><div class="erp-stat-icon">${c.icon}</div><div class="erp-stat-info"><span class="erp-stat-value" data-stat-id="${c.id}">...</span><span class="erp-stat-label">${escapeHtml(isArabic?c.labelAr:c.labelEn)}</span></div></div>`).join("")}</div>`;if(window.frappe)statsCards.forEach(c=>c.fetch().then(v=>{const el=statsSection.querySelector(`[data-stat-id="${c.id}"]`);if(el)el.textContent=formatNumber(v);}));}

  function renderQuickActions(){if(!quickActions)return;quickActions.innerHTML=`<h2 class="erp-section-title">${escapeHtml(isArabic?"اختصارات سريعة":"Quick Actions")}</h2><div class="erp-quick-grid">${quickActionButtons.map(b=>`<button type="button" class="erp-quick-btn" data-new-doc="${escapeHtml(b.doctype)}" ${b.isReport?'data-is-report="1"':""} style="--btn-color:${b.color}"><span class="erp-quick-icon">${b.icon}</span><span class="erp-quick-label">${escapeHtml(isArabic?b.labelAr:b.labelEn)}</span></button>`).join("")}</div>`;quickActions.addEventListener("click",e=>{const b=e.target.closest("[data-new-doc]");if(!b||!window.frappe)return;if(b.dataset.isReport==="1"){frappe.set_route("query-report",b.dataset.newDoc);return;}if(typeof frappe.new_doc==="function")frappe.new_doc(b.dataset.newDoc);});}

  function renderSections(){root.setAttribute("dir",isArabic?"rtl":"ltr");root.classList.toggle("erp-dashboard-rtl",isArabic);content.innerHTML=sections.map((s,si)=>{const ch=s[1].map((c,ci)=>{const lh=c[2].map(i=>{const d=itemDescriptions[i],dl=isArabic?"تفاصيل":"Details",ib=d?`<button type="button" class="erp-info-link" data-info-item="${escapeHtml(i)}">${dl}</button>`:"";return`<div class="erp-link-row"><button type="button" class="erp-link" data-route-name="${escapeHtml(i)}"><span class="erp-link-text">${escapeHtml(translate(i))}</span><span class="erp-link-arrow">${isArabic?"←":"→"}</span></button>${ib}</div>`;}).join("");return`<article class="erp-card tone-${(si+ci)%5}" data-erp-card><button type="button" class="erp-card-heading" data-card-toggle aria-expanded="false"><span class="erp-icon">${c[1]}</span><span class="erp-card-title">${escapeHtml(translate(c[0]))}</span><span class="erp-card-chevron">⌄</span></button><div class="erp-card-links">${lh}</div></article>`;}).join("");return`<section class="erp-module-section"><h2 class="erp-section-title">${escapeHtml(translate(s[0]))}</h2><div class="erp-dashboard-grid">${ch}</div></section>`;}).join("");}

  function renderFooter(){if(!footerEl)return;const l=footerInfo.labels,p=isArabic?l.phoneAr:l.phoneEn,e=isArabic?l.emailAr:l.emailEn,w=isArabic?l.websiteAr:l.websiteEn;footerEl.innerHTML=`<div class="erp-footer-inner"><div class="erp-footer-item"><span class="erp-footer-icon">📞</span><span class="erp-footer-label">${escapeHtml(p)}:</span><a href="tel:${footerInfo.phone}" class="erp-footer-link" dir="ltr">${escapeHtml(footerInfo.phone)}</a></div><span class="erp-footer-sep">|</span><div class="erp-footer-item"><span class="erp-footer-icon">✉️</span><span class="erp-footer-label">${escapeHtml(e)}:</span><a href="mailto:${footerInfo.email}" class="erp-footer-link">${escapeHtml(footerInfo.email)}</a></div><span class="erp-footer-sep">|</span><div class="erp-footer-item"><span class="erp-footer-icon">🌐</span><span class="erp-footer-label">${escapeHtml(w)}:</span><a href="https://${footerInfo.website}" class="erp-footer-link" target="_blank" rel="noopener">${escapeHtml(footerInfo.website)}</a></div></div>`;}

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
     Routing
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  function openRoute(n){if(!window.frappe||typeof frappe.set_route!=="function")return;if(reportNames.has(n)){frappe.set_route("query-report",n);return;}if(singleDocs.has(n)){frappe.set_route("Form",n);return;}if(treeDocs.has(n)){const treeMap={"Item Group":"Item Group","Warehouse":"Warehouse"};frappe.set_route("Tree",treeMap[n]||n);return;}frappe.set_route("List",n);}

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
     Event Delegation
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  let lastToggleTime=0;
  content.addEventListener("click",event=>{const ib=event.target.closest("[data-info-item]");if(ib){event.preventDefault();event.stopPropagation();const d=itemDescriptions[ib.dataset.infoItem];if(d)showInfoModal({icon:d.icon||"📄",labelAr:translate(ib.dataset.infoItem),labelEn:ib.dataset.infoItem,summaryAr:d.summaryAr,summaryEn:d.summaryEn,stepsAr:d.stepsAr,stepsEn:d.stepsEn});return;}const rb=event.target.closest("[data-route-name]");if(rb){event.preventDefault();event.stopPropagation();openRoute(rb.dataset.routeName);return;}const cb=event.target.closest("[data-card-toggle]");if(!cb)return;const now=Date.now();if(now-lastToggleTime<400)return;lastToggleTime=now;const sc=cb.closest("[data-erp-card]");if(!sc)return;const so=!sc.classList.contains("is-open");content.querySelectorAll("[data-erp-card]").forEach(c=>{if(c!==sc){c.classList.remove("is-open");c.querySelector("[data-card-toggle]")?.setAttribute("aria-expanded","false");}});if(so){sc.classList.add("is-open");cb.setAttribute("aria-expanded","true");}else{sc.classList.remove("is-open");cb.setAttribute("aria-expanded","false");}});

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
     Init
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  renderStats();renderQuickActions();renderSections();renderFooter();
})();

     ١٠. دوال مساعدة
  ───────────────────────────────────────── */

  function translate(name) {
    if (!isArabic) return name;
    if (arabicFallback[name]) return arabicFallback[name];
    if (typeof window.__ === "function") return window.__(name);
    return name;
  }

  function escapeHtml(value) {
    return String(value ?? "")
      .replaceAll("&", "&")
      .replaceAll("<", "<")
      .replaceAll(">", ">")
      .replaceAll('"', """)
      .replaceAll("'", "'");
  }

  function formatNumber(num) {
    const n = parseFloat(num) || 0;
    if (n % 1 !== 0) {
      return n.toLocaleString("en-US", {
        minimumFractionDigits: 2,
        maximumFractionDigits: 2
      });
    }
    return n.toLocaleString("en-US");
  }


  /* ─────────────────────────────────────────
     ١١. إنشاء بطاقات الإحصائيات
  ───────────────────────────────────────── */

  function renderStats() {
    if (!statsSection) return;

    statsSection.innerHTML = `
      <div class="erp-stats-grid">
        ${statsCards
          .map((card) => {
            const label = isArabic
              ? card.labelAr
              : card.labelEn;

            return `
              <div
                class="erp-stat-card"
                style="--stat-color: ${card.color}"
              >
                <div class="erp-stat-icon">${card.icon}</div>
                <div class="erp-stat-info">
                  <span
                    class="erp-stat-value"
                    data-stat-id="${card.id}"
                  >...</span>
                  <span class="erp-stat-label">
                    ${escapeHtml(label)}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            `;
          })
          .join("")}
      </div>
    `;

    if (window.frappe) {
      statsCards.forEach((card) => {
        card.fetch().then((value) => {
          const el = statsSection.querySelector(
            `[data-stat-id="${card.id}"]`
          );
          if (!el) return;

          let display = formatNumber(value);
          if (card.suffix) {
            const suffixText = isArabic
              ? card.suffix.ar
              : card.suffix.en;
            display += ` ${suffixText}`;
          }
          el.textContent = display;
        });
      });
    }
  }


  /* ─────────────────────────────────────────
     ١٢. مربع التفاصيل (Modal)

     يظهر عند الضغط على زر "تفاصيل"
     بجانب العنصر داخل البطاقة.

     المرحلة ١: وصف مختصر + زر "عرض الخطوات"
     المرحلة ٢: الوصف + الخطوات المرقّمة
  ───────────────────────────────────────── */

  function showInfoModal(data) {
    /*
     * تحديد النصوص حسب اللغة.
     */
    const title = isArabic
      ? data.labelAr
      : data.labelEn;

    const summary = isArabic
      ? data.summaryAr
      : data.summaryEn;

    const steps = isArabic
      ? data.stepsAr
      : data.stepsEn;

    const hasSteps =
      Array.isArray(steps) && steps.length > 0;

    const showStepsText = isArabic
      ? "📖 عرض الخطوات"
      : "📖 Show Steps";

    const hideStepsText = isArabic
      ? "📖 إخفاء الخطوات"
      : "📖 Hide Steps";

    /*
     * إنشاء الخطوات المرقّمة كـ HTML.
     */
    let stepsHtml = "";
    if (hasSteps) {
      stepsHtml = `
        <div class="erp-modal-steps" data-modal-steps>
          <ol class="erp-modal-steps-list">
            ${steps
              .map(
                (step) =>
                  `<li>${escapeHtml(step)}</li>`
              )
              .join("")}
          </ol>
        </div>
      `;
    }

    /*
     * إنشاء عنصر الـ Modal وإضافته للصفحة.
     */
    const overlay = document.createElement("div");
    overlay.className = "erp-modal-overlay";
    overlay.setAttribute(
      "dir",
      isArabic ? "rtl" : "ltr"
    );

    overlay.innerHTML = `
      <div class="erp-modal-box">

        <button
          type="button"
          class="erp-modal-close"
          data-modal-close
          aria-label="Close"
        >✕</button>

        <div class="erp-modal-header">
          <span class="erp-modal-icon">${data.icon}</span>
          <h3 class="erp-modal-title">
            ${escapeHtml(title)}
          </h3>
        </div>

        <p class="erp-modal-summary">
          ${escapeHtml(summary)}
        </p>

        ${
          hasSteps
            ? `<button
                type="button"
                class="erp-modal-toggle-steps"
                data-toggle-steps
              >${showStepsText}</button>`
            : ""
        }

        ${stepsHtml}

      </div>
    `;

    root.appendChild(overlay);

    /*
     * أنيميشن الظهور.
     */
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      overlay.classList.add("is-visible");
    });

    /*
     * إغلاق المربع.
     */
    function closeModal() {
      overlay.classList.remove("is-visible");
      overlay.addEventListener(
        "transitionend",
        () => overlay.remove(),
        { once: true }
      );
    }

    overlay
      .querySelector("[data-modal-close]")
      .addEventListener("click", closeModal);

    overlay.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
      if (e.target === overlay) closeModal();
    });

    /*
     * زر عرض/إخفاء الخطوات.
     */
    const toggleBtn = overlay.querySelector(
      "[data-toggle-steps]"
    );
    const stepsContainer = overlay.querySelector(
      "[data-modal-steps]"
    );

    if (toggleBtn && stepsContainer) {
      toggleBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
        const isShowing =
          stepsContainer.classList.contains("is-shown");

        if (isShowing) {
          stepsContainer.classList.remove("is-shown");
          toggleBtn.textContent = showStepsText;
        } else {
          stepsContainer.classList.add("is-shown");
          toggleBtn.textContent = hideStepsText;
        }
      });
    }
  }


  /* ─────────────────────────────────────────
     ١٣. إنشاء أزرار الاختصارات السريعة
     (الشكل الأصلي — بدون أيقونة معلومات)
  ───────────────────────────────────────── */

  function renderQuickActions() {
    if (!quickActions) return;

    const title = isArabic
      ? "اختصارات سريعة"
      : "Quick Actions";

    quickActions.innerHTML = `
      <h2 class="erp-section-title">
        ${escapeHtml(title)}
      </h2>

      <div class="erp-quick-grid">
        ${quickActionButtons
          .map((btn) => {
            const label = isArabic
              ? btn.labelAr
              : btn.labelEn;

            return `
              <button
                type="button"
                class="erp-quick-btn"
                data-new-doc="${escapeHtml(btn.doctype)}"
                style="--btn-color: ${btn.color}"
              >
                <span
                  class="erp-quick-icon"
                  aria-hidden="true"
                >${btn.icon}</span>

                <span class="erp-quick-label">
                  ${escapeHtml(label)}
                </span>
              </button>
            `;
          })
          .join("")}
      </div>
    `;

    /*
     * حدث الضغط — يفتح مستند جديد.
     */
    quickActions.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
      const btn = event.target.closest("[data-new-doc]");
      if (!btn) return;

      const doctype = btn.dataset.newDoc;
      if (
        window.frappe &&
        typeof frappe.new_doc === "function"
      ) {
        frappe.new_doc(doctype);
      }
    });
  }


  /* ─────────────────────────────────────────
     ١٤. إنشاء بطاقات التقارير والماسترز
     
     العناصر الموجودة في itemDescriptions
     يظهر بجانبها زر "تفاصيل".
  ───────────────────────────────────────── */

  function renderSections() {
    root.setAttribute(
      "dir",
      isArabic ? "rtl" : "ltr"
    );

    root.classList.toggle(
      "erp-dashboard-rtl",
      isArabic
    );

    content.innerHTML = sections
      .map((section, sectionIndex) => {
        const sectionName = section[0];
        const sectionCards = section[1];

        const cardsHtml = sectionCards
          .map((card, cardIndex) => {
            const cardName = card[0];
            const icon = card[1];
            const items = card[2];

            /*
             * إنشاء روابط الخيارات داخل كل بطاقة.
             * إذا كان العنصر موجوداً في itemDescriptions
             * يُضاف بجانبه زر "تفاصيل".
             */
            const linksHtml = items
              .map((itemName) => {
                const desc =
                  itemDescriptions[itemName];

                const detailsLabel = isArabic
                  ? "تفاصيل"
                  : "Details";

                const infoBtn = desc
                  ? `<button
                      type="button"
                      class="erp-info-link"
                      data-info-item="${escapeHtml(itemName)}"
                    >${detailsLabel}</button>`
                  : "";

                return `
                  <div class="erp-link-row">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      class="erp-link"
                      data-route-name="${escapeHtml(itemName)}"
                    >
                      <span class="erp-link-text">
                        ${escapeHtml(translate(itemName))}
                      </span>
                      <span
                        class="erp-link-arrow"
                        aria-hidden="true"
                      >${isArabic ? "←" : "→"}</span>
                    </button>
                    ${infoBtn}
                  </div>
                `;
              })
              .join("");

            return `
              <article
                class="erp-card tone-${(sectionIndex + cardIndex) % 5}"
                data-erp-card
              >
                <button
                  type="button"
                  class="erp-card-heading"
                  data-card-toggle
                  aria-expanded="false"
                >
                  <span class="erp-icon" aria-hidden="true">
                    ${icon}
                  </span>
                  <span class="erp-card-title">
                    ${escapeHtml(translate(cardName))}
                  </span>
                  <span class="erp-card-chevron" aria-hidden="true">
                    ⌄
                  </span>
                </button>
                <div class="erp-card-links">
                  ${linksHtml}
                </div>
              </article>
            `;
          })
          .join("");

        return `
          <section class="erp-module-section">
            <h2 class="erp-section-title">
              ${escapeHtml(translate(sectionName))}
            </h2>
            <div class="erp-dashboard-grid">
              ${cardsHtml}
            </div>
          </section>
        `;
      })
      .join("");
  }


  /* ─────────────────────────────────────────
     ١٥. إنشاء الفوتر
  ───────────────────────────────────────── */

  function renderFooter() {
    if (!footerEl) return;

    const labels = footerInfo.labels;
    const phoneLabel = isArabic
      ? labels.phoneAr
      : labels.phoneEn;
    const emailLabel = isArabic
      ? labels.emailAr
      : labels.emailEn;
    const websiteLabel = isArabic
      ? labels.websiteAr
      : labels.websiteEn;

    footerEl.innerHTML = `
      <div class="erp-footer-inner">
        <div class="erp-footer-item">
          <span class="erp-footer-icon">📞</span>
          <span class="erp-footer-label">
            ${escapeHtml(phoneLabel)}:
          </span>
          <a href="tel:${footerInfo.phone}"
            class="erp-footer-link" dir="ltr"
          >${escapeHtml(footerInfo.phone)}</a>
        </div>

        <span class="erp-footer-sep">|</span>

        <div class="erp-footer-item">
          <span class="erp-footer-icon">✉️</span>
          <span class="erp-footer-label">
            ${escapeHtml(emailLabel)}:
          </span>
          <a href="mailto:${footerInfo.email}"
            class="erp-footer-link"
          >${escapeHtml(footerInfo.email)}</a>
        </div>

        <span class="erp-footer-sep">|</span>

        <div class="erp-footer-item">
          <span class="erp-footer-icon">🌐</span>
          <span class="erp-footer-label">
            ${escapeHtml(websiteLabel)}:
          </span>
          <a href="https://${footerInfo.website}"
            class="erp-footer-link"
            target="_blank" rel="noopener"
          >${escapeHtml(footerInfo.website)}</a>
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
  }


  /* ─────────────────────────────────────────
     ١٦. فتح الخيار داخل ERPNext
  ───────────────────────────────────────── */

  function openRoute(name) {
    if (
      !window.frappe ||
      typeof frappe.set_route !== "function"
    ) {
      return;
    }

    if (reportNames.has(name)) {
      frappe.set_route("query-report", name);
      return;
    }

    if (singleDocs.has(name)) {
      frappe.set_route("Form", name);
      return;
    }

    frappe.set_route("List", name);
  }


  /* ─────────────────────────────────────────
     ١٧. أحداث الضغط على البطاقات والروابط
  ───────────────────────────────────────── */

  let lastToggleTime = 0;

  content.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
    /*
     * ① الضغط على زر "تفاصيل" بجانب عنصر داخل البطاقة.
     *    يفتح مربع Modal بالوصف والخطوات.
     */
    const infoBtn = event.target.closest(
      "[data-info-item]"
    );
    if (infoBtn) {
      event.preventDefault();
      event.stopPropagation();
      const itemName = infoBtn.dataset.infoItem;
      const desc = itemDescriptions[itemName];
      if (desc) {
        showInfoModal({
          icon: desc.icon || "📄",
          labelAr: translate(itemName),
          labelEn: itemName,
          summaryAr: desc.summaryAr,
          summaryEn: desc.summaryEn,
          stepsAr: desc.stepsAr,
          stepsEn: desc.stepsEn
        });
      }
      return;
    }

    /*
     * ② الضغط على رابط خيار داخل بطاقة.
     *    يفتح القائمة أو التقرير أو الإعدادات.
     */
    const routeButton = event.target.closest(
      "[data-route-name]"
    );
    if (routeButton) {
      event.preventDefault();
      event.stopPropagation();
      openRoute(routeButton.dataset.routeName);
      return;
    }

    /*
     * ③ الضغط على عنوان البطاقة لفتحها أو إغلاقها.
     */
    const cardButton = event.target.closest(
      "[data-card-toggle]"
    );
    if (!cardButton) return;

    const now = Date.now();
    if (now - lastToggleTime < 400) return;
    lastToggleTime = now;

    const selectedCard = cardButton.closest(
      "[data-erp-card]"
    );
    if (!selectedCard) return;

    const shouldOpen =
      !selectedCard.classList.contains("is-open");

    content
      .querySelectorAll("[data-erp-card]")
      .forEach((card) => {
        if (card !== selectedCard) {
          card.classList.remove("is-open");
          card
            .querySelector("[data-card-toggle]")
            ?.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
        }
      });

    if (shouldOpen) {
      selectedCard.classList.add("is-open");
      cardButton.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
    } else {
      selectedCard.classList.remove("is-open");
      cardButton.setAttribute(
        "aria-expanded",
        "false"
      );
    }
  });


  /* ─────────────────────────────────────────
     ١٨. تشغيل إنشاء جميع الأقسام
  ───────────────────────────────────────── */

  renderStats();
  renderQuickActions();
  renderSections();
  renderFooter();
})();

  function translate(n){if(!isArabic)return n;return arabicFallback[n]||(typeof window.__==="function"?window.__(n):n);}
  function escapeHtml(v){return String(v??"").replaceAll("&","&").replaceAll("<","<").replaceAll(">",">").replaceAll('"',""").replaceAll("'","'");}
  function formatNumber(n){return(parseFloat(n)||0).toLocaleString("en-US");}

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
     Modal
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  function showInfoModal(data){const title=isArabic?data.labelAr:data.labelEn,summary=isArabic?data.summaryAr:data.summaryEn,steps=isArabic?data.stepsAr:data.stepsEn,hasSteps=Array.isArray(steps)&&steps.length>0;const showT=isArabic?"📖 عرض الخطوات":"📖 Show Steps",hideT=isArabic?"📖 إخفاء الخطوات":"📖 Hide Steps";let stepsHtml=hasSteps?`<div class="erp-modal-steps" data-modal-steps><ol class="erp-modal-steps-list">${steps.map(s=>`<li>${escapeHtml(s)}</li>`).join("")}</ol></div>`:"";const overlay=document.createElement("div");overlay.className="erp-modal-overlay";overlay.setAttribute("dir",isArabic?"rtl":"ltr");overlay.innerHTML=`<div class="erp-modal-box"><button type="button" class="erp-modal-close" data-modal-close>✕</button><div class="erp-modal-header"><span class="erp-modal-icon">${data.icon}</span><h3 class="erp-modal-title">${escapeHtml(title)}</h3></div><p class="erp-modal-summary">${escapeHtml(summary)}</p>${hasSteps?`<button type="button" class="erp-modal-toggle-steps" data-toggle-steps>${showT}</button>`:""} ${stepsHtml}</div>`;root.appendChild(overlay);requestAnimationFrame(()=>overlay.classList.add("is-visible"));function closeModal(){overlay.classList.remove("is-visible");overlay.addEventListener("transitionend",()=>overlay.remove(),{once:true});}overlay.querySelector("[data-modal-close]").addEventListener("click",closeModal);overlay.addEventListener("click",e=>{if(e.target===overlay)closeModal();});const tb=overlay.querySelector("[data-toggle-steps]"),sc=overlay.querySelector("[data-modal-steps]");if(tb&&sc){tb.addEventListener("click",()=>{sc.classList.toggle("is-shown");tb.textContent=sc.classList.contains("is-shown")?hideT:showT;});}}

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
     Render

  function renderStats(){if(!statsSection)return;statsSection.innerHTML=`<div class="erp-stats-grid">${statsCards.map(c=>`<div class="erp-stat-card" style="--stat-color:${c.color}"><div class="erp-stat-icon">${c.icon}</div><div class="erp-stat-info"><span class="erp-stat-value" data-stat-id="${c.id}">...</span><span class="erp-stat-label">${escapeHtml(isArabic?c.labelAr:c.labelEn)}</span></div></div>`).join("")}</div>`;if(window.frappe)statsCards.forEach(c=>c.fetch().then(v=>{const el=statsSection.querySelector(`[data-stat-id="${c.id}"]`);if(el)el.textContent=formatNumber(v);}));}

  function renderQuickActions(){if(!quickActions)return;quickActions.innerHTML=`<h2 class="erp-section-title">${escapeHtml(isArabic?"اختصارات سريعة":"Quick Actions")}</h2><div class="erp-quick-grid">${quickActionButtons.map(b=>`<button type="button" class="erp-quick-btn" data-new-doc="${escapeHtml(b.doctype)}" style="--btn-color:${b.color}"><span class="erp-quick-icon">${b.icon}</span><span class="erp-quick-label">${escapeHtml(isArabic?b.labelAr:b.labelEn)}</span></button>`).join("")}</div>`;quickActions.addEventListener("click",e=>{const b=e.target.closest("[data-new-doc]");if(!b||!window.frappe)return;if(typeof frappe.new_doc==="function")frappe.new_doc(b.dataset.newDoc);});}

  function renderSections(){root.setAttribute("dir",isArabic?"rtl":"ltr");root.classList.toggle("erp-dashboard-rtl",isArabic);content.innerHTML=sections.map((s,si)=>{const ch=s[1].map((c,ci)=>{const lh=c[2].map(i=>{const d=itemDescriptions[i],dl=isArabic?"تفاصيل":"Details",ib=d?`<button type="button" class="erp-info-link" data-info-item="${escapeHtml(i)}">${dl}</button>`:"";return`<div class="erp-link-row"><button type="button" class="erp-link" data-route-name="${escapeHtml(i)}"><span class="erp-link-text">${escapeHtml(translate(i))}</span><span class="erp-link-arrow">${isArabic?"←":"→"}</span></button>${ib}</div>`;}).join("");return`<article class="erp-card tone-${(si+ci)%5}" data-erp-card><button type="button" class="erp-card-heading" data-card-toggle aria-expanded="false"><span class="erp-icon">${c[1]}</span><span class="erp-card-title">${escapeHtml(translate(c[0]))}</span><span class="erp-card-chevron">⌄</span></button><div class="erp-card-links">${lh}</div></article>`;}).join("");return`<section class="erp-module-section"><h2 class="erp-section-title">${escapeHtml(translate(s[0]))}</h2><div class="erp-dashboard-grid">${ch}</div></section>`;}).join("");}

  function renderFooter(){if(!footerEl)return;const l=footerInfo.labels,p=isArabic?l.phoneAr:l.phoneEn,e=isArabic?l.emailAr:l.emailEn,w=isArabic?l.websiteAr:l.websiteEn;footerEl.innerHTML=`<div class="erp-footer-inner"><div class="erp-footer-item"><span class="erp-footer-icon">📞</span><span class="erp-footer-label">${escapeHtml(p)}:</span><a href="tel:${footerInfo.phone}" class="erp-footer-link" dir="ltr">${escapeHtml(footerInfo.phone)}</a></div><span class="erp-footer-sep">|</span><div class="erp-footer-item"><span class="erp-footer-icon">✉️</span><span class="erp-footer-label">${escapeHtml(e)}:</span><a href="mailto:${footerInfo.email}" class="erp-footer-link">${escapeHtml(footerInfo.email)}</a></div><span class="erp-footer-sep">|</span><div class="erp-footer-item"><span class="erp-footer-icon">🌐</span><span class="erp-footer-label">${escapeHtml(w)}:</span><a href="https://${footerInfo.website}" class="erp-footer-link" target="_blank" rel="noopener">${escapeHtml(footerInfo.website)}</a></div></div>`;}

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
     Routing
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  function openRoute(n){if(!window.frappe||typeof frappe.set_route!=="function")return;if(reportNames.has(n)){frappe.set_route("query-report",n);return;}if(singleDocs.has(n)){frappe.set_route("Form",n);return;}if(treeDocs.has(n)){frappe.set_route("Tree",n);return;}frappe.set_route("List",n);}

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
     Event Delegation
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  let lastToggleTime=0;
  content.addEventListener("click",event=>{const ib=event.target.closest("[data-info-item]");if(ib){event.preventDefault();event.stopPropagation();const d=itemDescriptions[ib.dataset.infoItem];if(d)showInfoModal({icon:d.icon||"📄",labelAr:translate(ib.dataset.infoItem),labelEn:ib.dataset.infoItem,summaryAr:d.summaryAr,summaryEn:d.summaryEn,stepsAr:d.stepsAr,stepsEn:d.stepsEn});return;}const rb=event.target.closest("[data-route-name]");if(rb){event.preventDefault();event.stopPropagation();openRoute(rb.dataset.routeName);return;}const cb=event.target.closest("[data-card-toggle]");if(!cb)return;const now=Date.now();if(now-lastToggleTime<400)return;lastToggleTime=now;const sc=cb.closest("[data-erp-card]");if(!sc)return;const so=!sc.classList.contains("is-open");content.querySelectorAll("[data-erp-card]").forEach(c=>{if(c!==sc){c.classList.remove("is-open");c.querySelector("[data-card-toggle]")?.setAttribute("aria-expanded","false");}});if(so){sc.classList.add("is-open");cb.setAttribute("aria-expanded","true");}else{sc.classList.remove("is-open");cb.setAttribute("aria-expanded","false");}});

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
     Init
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  renderStats();renderQuickActions();renderSections();renderFooter();
})();
